import { cpus } from "node:os";

const SERIAL = 1;
const MODULE_WIDTH = Math.min(1, cpus().length);

// CASE js_let_min_one expect=fire
export async function letMinOne(items, op, n) {
  let width = Math.min(1, n);
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE js_var_min_one expect=fire
export async function varMinOne(items, op, n) {
  var width = Math.min(1, n);
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE js_module_min_one expect=fire
export async function moduleMinOne(items, op) {
  await mapLimit(items, MODULE_WIDTH, op);
}

// CASE js_module_const_one expect=fire
export async function moduleConstOne(items, op) {
  await mapLimit(items, SERIAL, op);
}

// CASE js_local_const_one expect=fire
export async function localConstOne(items, op) {
  const width = 1;
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE js_options_width_from_min expect=fire
export async function optionsFromMin(items, op, n) {
  const concurrency = Math.min(1, n);
  await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}

// CASE js_options_width_from_local_one expect=fire
export async function optionsFromOne(items, op) {
  const concurrency = 1;
  await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}
